integrity: The mathematical proof gives all-parameter statements; the standard-library checker verifies finite rational identities only. No external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive three-member equal-loss exponential open cycles under 0<3*d*gamma<1/e only. The explicit no-rescue cone is sufficient but not sharp; complete full-text inspection of Pavlovich–Bratus (2012) was not possible. No independent validation.
title: A raywise extinction threshold and an unrescuable composition cone in a three-member open hypercycle
